say:1:1320829001:1.text: Hey, young fella! Did you find that bevel knife in the tavern?
say:1:1320829001:1.source_cn: 喂！小伙子！你手里的雕刻刀，是在酒馆捡到的吗？

say:4:1320829002:0.text: Bevel knife? I thought it was a knife for skinning. The shape is a bit weird.
say:4:1320829002:0.source_cn: 雕刻刀？这不是剥皮刀吗？虽然造型奇怪了点。

say:5:1320829003:1.text: If you look closely at the blade of the knife, you'll see that it's raised differently.
say:5:1320829003:1.source_cn: 你仔细看那把刀的刀头，凸起的刀刃形状各个不一样！

say:6:1320829004:1.text: It's designed for carving and sculpting at different angles. If you use it to skin an animal, the blade will be damaged, and the skin on the fur will lacerate.
say:6:1320829004:1.source_cn: 是为了在不同角度进行精细的雕琢，如果你拿去剥皮，刀刃会...

say:7:1320829005:1.text: Hey, I'm the one that found it! What I do with it is my business! I think the knife is fine for skinning a few rabbits.
say:7:1320829005:1.source_cn: 但这是我捡到的……！要怎么用是我的事！我看它好得很，剥...

say:8:1320829006:1.text: Gah! You youngsters are always breaking the rules! How can a bevel knife be used to skin animals?!
say:8:1320829006:1.source_cn: 啧，你们总是在这种事上打破规矩，刻刀怎么能用来剥皮呢……！

say:9:1320829007:1.text: You must not be the one doing the hunting, right?
say:9:1320829007:1.source_cn: 我知道了，狩猎的一定不是你吧？

say:10:1320829008:1.text: Yeah, my father does the hunting.

say:11:1320829009:1.text: I knew it. You don't hunt yourself, so you can't grasp the frustration when all your hard work gets spoiled by someone else.
say:11:1320829009:1.source_cn: 这就对了，你不是亲自狩猎的人，所以不知道付出辛劳后的收...

say:12:1320829010:1.text: For you, this knife can be used however you want. But for a sculptor, it's a very important tool.
say:12:1320829010:1.source_cn: 对于你来说这把刀的确怎么用都行，但对于雕工来说，这是重...

say:13:1320829011:1.text: My people have been working with Danica for centuries. She's like our own flesh and blood. Changing partners now, before the job's done, will wreak havoc on our final product!
say:13:1320829011:1.source_cn: 我的族人已经和丹妮卡合作上百年，她就像我们的孩子一样，...

say:15:1320829013:1.text: That bevel knife in your hand.
say:15:1320829013:1.source_cn: 你手里这把刻刀，确切地说，是斜刀。

say:16:1320829014:1.text: You used it for centuries? And you have a name for it?
say:16:1320829014:1.source_cn: 用……用了上百年？而且你……你怎么称呼它？

say:17:1320829015:1.text: Danica is still a young, spirited girl. She's just unhappy to be in your hands right now!
say:17:1320829015:1.source_cn: 怎么，丹妮卡还年轻得很，是个很有精神的小姑娘，而且很不...

say:18:1320829016:1.text: This knife has a girl's name... Either I'm going crazy, or you're really crazy.
say:18:1320829016:1.source_cn: 疯了……管这么一把刀叫姑娘……不是我疯了就是你疯了。

say:19:1320829017:1.text: I want nothing to do with this weird old knife. Here! Take it back!
say:19:1320829017:1.source_cn: 上百年的旧刀，我也不想用，你们想要那就拿回去！

say:21:1320829018:1.text: Yay! We got the knife back!
say:21:1320829018:1.source_cn: 总算把雕刻刀拿回来了！

say:22:1320829019:1.text: If this set of tools is centuries old...
say:22:1320829019:1.source_cn: 竟然连一套刀具都用了上百年……

choice_prompt:23:1320829019.text: If this set of tools is centuries old...
choice_prompt:23:1320829019.source_cn: 竟然连一套刀具都用了上百年……

say:24:1320829020:1.text: I was too busy admiring Danica. What are you all talking about? Oh, I just gave her a good oil down, too.
say:24:1320829020:1.source_cn: 嚯嚯，你们在说什么？我给丹妮卡好好保养了一番，用了上好...

say:25:1320829021:1.text: Anyway, let's escort this beautiful girl home.
say:25:1320829021:1.source_cn: 走，该送这小姑娘回家了。

choice:23:2:3.text: Let's not ask about someone's age.
choice:23:2:3.source_cn: 好了，别试图打听别人的年龄
choice:23:2:3.male: Let's not ask about someone's age.
choice:23:2:3.female: Let's not ask about someone's age.
